source_conventions: Preserve literal native indices and executed conditions. Source comments do not replace branch conditions. Source-corrected estimators are separate and cannot silently alter the reproduction target.

Photometry peak/trough latency uses the7229-point linspace(-5,10) clock. Locate nearest zero and final-window bin; use the first native maximum/minimum in the inclusive slice. Convert its one-based position as index/(1/(T[3]-T[2]))*1000 milliseconds, without subtracting one. The physical zero-offset-corrected latency is a separately named estimator.

Native mean-trace baseline operations use their literal source-selected rows/windows. baselineCorrect uses the minimum over the time samples of the mean across supplied rows (omit NaNs), not a private independently recentered query. Keep target-binned native AUC in reproduction; the protected prospective reference instead uses the separately defined query-local processed_epoch_integral.

The selected blocks helper uses std divided by sqrt(selected row count), including its literal native grouping/normalization. The selected sem helper uses its exact native dimension denominator, not a substituted nonmissing-count rule. No standard-error-to-standard-deviation reinterpretation.

For native next-ITI analyses, preserve the executed trial-type selection, same-day/TrialNumber joins, full-rat or session trimming/z-score/quartiles exactly. These are retrospective source operations and are not prospective predictors or causal effects.
